# Airbnb

> > Global platform for vacation rentals, unique homes, experiences, and services connecting hosts with travelers worldwide.

Airbnb is expanding beyond accommodations with the 2025 Summer Release introducing Airbnb Services and enhanced Experiences, led by CEO Brian Chesky. The platform enables hosts, service providers, and renters to earn income while offering travelers comprehensive booking solutions.

## Key Topics

- Airbnb Services

## Product Announcements & News

- [2025 Summer Release: Now you can Airbnb more than an Airbnb](https://news.airbnb.com/airbnb-2025-summer-release/): Brian Chesky announces Airbnb Services, Experiences, and new app redesign
- [Airbnb 2025 Summer Release - Product Details](https://news.airbnb.com/product-releases/airbnb-2025-summer-release/): Product launch details for Airbnb Services and Experiences summer release
- [Airbnb Newsroom](https://news.airbnb.com/): Official newsroom for Airbnb announcements, press releases, and company news

## For Hosts & Service Providers

- [Offer your service on Airbnb](https://www.airbnb.com/host/services): Service provider onboarding for photographers, chefs, trainers via Airbnb
- [Earn with Airbnb-friendly apartments](https://www.airbnb.com/airbnb-friendly): Partner apartments allowing renters to host and earn on Airbnb platform
